master.note: Built locally, NOT by the firmware team's release toolchain. Hardware-validated on two leader units upgraded from 1.2.0: IMU and encoder both stream at ~99 Hz under a concurrent 100 Hz command load with zero retries or ACK timeouts, the two diagnostic commands answer with real data (they NACK on 1.2.0), and debug_tx_bytes stays 0. It replaces an official, validated 1.2.1 image; the trade is three defect fixes that live in code both roles share - command-channel livelock, blocking-log stalls, a per-boot out-of-bounds write - against the loss of that provenance. POWER-CYCLE THE GRIPPER AFTER FLASHING; see tc-gu-01 issue #6.

slave.protocol: V2.2 + 运动安全包络(GripperConfig.reserved 覆盖,协议不变)
slave.note: 本地构建,非固件团队发布工具链。相对 1.1.5 新增:MIT 路径的运动安全包络(误差钳位 + 力矩钳位,覆盖在 gripper_config_t.reserved[16] 上,命令 0x66/0x67 与载荷长度不变)、I2t 零速持续力矩降额、可配温度墙(默认 90/100 摄氏度)、min_open_rad 存控制可达行程。硬件验证(TCGU01A28Z0018s,24V):限速 8.68->1.70 rad/s;应索要 5.72Nm 实际 1.569Nm;kp 8->120(15x)力矩离散 1.4%;力位混合力矩保持在 91 摄氏度起降额、94 摄氏度/1.370Nm 平衡;客户 gripper_loose_problem 复现件(kp=20 裸 submit_impedance 压到全闭)包络关闭时整机掉电重启、开启时 25 秒稳定夹持无故障。已知未验证:力矩天花板(rated_torque_nm)层从未在硬件上触发;24V 欠压阈值只夹逼到 4.5Nm 存活、6.0Nm 未测;裸阻抗在 100 摄氏度墙下的平衡值未测到。刷完必须断电重启 —— 除 bank-swap 软复位丢帧外,min_open_rad 也只在下次开机自标定时写入。
